CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION matchmaking_private.state_impl()
 RETURNS TABLE(state text, queue_topic text, match_id uuid, match_topic text, join_code text, seat smallint, is_host boolean, player_count smallint, match_status text, protocol_version integer, engine_build text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
declare
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
begin
  if v_uid is null then
    raise exception 'Authentication required';
  end if;

  perform matchmaking_private.cleanup();

  return query
  select
    case when m.status = 'active' then 'active' else 'matched' end::text,
    ('queue:' || v_uid::text)::text,
    m.id,
    m.topic,
    m.join_code,
    mp.seat,
    (m.host_user_id = v_uid),
    m.player_count,
    m.status,
    m.protocol_version,
    m.engine_build
  from public.match_players mp
  join public.matches m on m.id = mp.match_id
  where mp.user_id = v_uid
    and mp.left_at is null
    and m.status in ('waiting','ready','active')
  order by m.created_at desc
  limit 1;

  if found then
    return;
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1 from matchmaking_private.quick_queue q
    where q.user_id = v_uid and q.expires_at > now()
  ) then
    return query
    select
      'queued'::text,
      ('queue:' || v_uid::text)::text,
      null::uuid,
      null::text,
      null::text,
      null::smallint,
      false,
      q.player_count,
      null::text,
      q.protocol_version,
      q.engine_build
    from matchmaking_private.quick_queue q
    where q.user_id = v_uid;
    return;
  end if;

  return query
  select
    'idle'::text,
    ('queue:' || v_uid::text)::text,
    null::uuid,
    null::text,
    null::text,
    null::smallint,
    false,
    null::smallint,
    null::text,
    null::integer,
    null::text;
end;
$function$

functions.name: cleanup
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION matchmaking_private.cleanup()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
begin
  delete from matchmaking_private.quick_queue
  where expires_at <= now();

  delete from matchmaking_private.rate_limits
  where window_start < now() - interval '1 day';

  update public.matches as m
  set status = 'cancelled',
      ended_at = coalesce(m.ended_at, now()),
      updated_at = now(),
      revision = m.revision + 1
  where m.status in ('waiting','ready')
    and m.expires_at <= now();
end;
$function$

functions.name: can_read_topic
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION matchmaking_private.can_read_topic(p_topic text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  select
    auth.uid() is not null
    and (
      p_topic = 'queue:' || auth.uid()::text
      or exists (
        select 1
        from public.match_players me
        join public.matches m on m.id = me.match_id
        where me.user_id = auth.uid()
          and me.left_at is null
          and m.topic = p_topic
          and m.status <> 'cancelled'
      )
      or exists (
        select 1
        from public.matches m
        join matchmaking_private.match_transport mt on mt.match_id = m.id
        join public.match_players me on me.match_id = m.id
        join public.match_players target on target.match_id = m.id
        where me.user_id = auth.uid()
          and me.left_at is null
          and target.left_at is null
          and m.status = 'active'
          and p_topic =
            'game:' || m.id::text || ':' || mt.transport_key || ':player:' || target.user_id::text
          and (
            target.user_id = auth.uid()
            or m.host_user_id = auth.uid()
          )
      )
    );
$function$

functions.name: can_send_broadcast
functions.arguments: p_topic text, p_event text, p_payload jsonb
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION matchmaking_private.can_send_broadcast(p_topic text, p_event text, p_payload jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  select
    auth.uid() is not null
    and octet_length(coalesce(p_payload, '{}'::jsonb)::text) <= 240000
    and coalesce(p_payload->>'sender_id','') = auth.uid()::text
    and (
      exists (
        select 1
        from public.match_players mp
        join public.matches m on m.id = mp.match_id
        where mp.user_id = auth.uid()
          and mp.left_at is null
          and m.topic = p_topic
          and m.status in ('waiting','ready','active')
          and p_event like 'lobby.%'
      )
      or exists (
        select 1
        from public.matches m
        join matchmaking_private.match_transport mt on mt.match_id = m.id
        join public.match_players me on me.match_id = m.id
        join public.match_players target on target.match_id = m.id
        where me.user_id = auth.uid()
          and me.left_at is null
          and target.left_at is null
          and m.status = 'active'
          and p_topic =
            'game:' || m.id::text || ':' || mt.transport_key || ':player:' || target.user_id::text
          and (
            (p_event like 'player.%' and target.user_id = auth.uid())
            or
            (p_event like 'host.%' and m.host_user_id = auth.uid())
          )
      )
    );
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION matchmaking_private.transport_impl(p_match_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(transport_key text, own_topic text, is_host boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
declare
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
begin
  if v_uid is null then raise exception 'Authentication required'; end if;

  return query
  select
    mt.transport_key,
    ('game:' || m.id::text || ':' || mt.transport_key || ':player:' || v_uid::text)::text,
    (m.host_user_id = v_uid)
  from public.matches m
  join matchmaking_private.match_transport mt on mt.match_id = m.id
  join public.match_players me on me.match_id = m.id
  where m.id = p_match_id
    and m.status = 'active'
    and me.user_id = v_uid
    and me.left_at is null;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Active match transport is not available to this user';
  end if;
end;
$function$
